name: PULSE / Humanoid Play Lab
assumptions: Conceptual 18 x 14 m arena, not reconstructed from a measured plan.
Target robot is an unspecified 1.2-1.8 m humanoid; actual hand reach and controller still need calibration.
Central 6 x 6 m is unobstructed; floor markings are visual only.
Ground collision is an infinite plane. Perimeter has a 2.4 m open entrance.
No robot/controller included. All props have actual MuJoCo dynamics; mocap test tool is demo only.
